name: Bedrock_DeFi
fix_description: In _amounts(), the function treats ETH and BTC tokens as equivalent in value (only adjusting for decimals, not price). When a user deposits WETH (18 decimals), it mints uniBTC as if 1 ETH = 1 BTC. Add an oracle price check to convert ETH value to BTC value before calculating the uniBTC mint amount.
difficulty_reasoning: The core bug is a very straightforward mint pricing/validation failure: the vault lets an attacker mint 200 uniBTC for 200 ETH with essentially a single call. The full replication adds a flash loan and two swaps, but these are standard monetization steps rather than protocol-complex exploit logic, so a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly.
